description: This file defines the 'Bug' class for the SuiteCRM project, extending the SugarBean base class. It includes properties representing bug attributes, relationships, and methods for database interactions, list view data, and notifications. The class is used to manage bug records within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: Bug
classes.description: Model class for bug records in SuiteCRM, handling database interactions, relationships, and display logic related to bugs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializer for the Bug class, sets up custom fields and maps field definitions.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the bug's name as summary text.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL query to retrieve a list of bugs, with optional ordering and filtering.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL query to export bug data with related information.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields for list views (currently minimal implementation).

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates related and detail fields such as release names.

methods.name: set_release
methods.description: Sets the name of the found-in release for display.

methods.name: set_fixed_in_release
methods.description: Sets the name of the fixed-in release for display.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list views, including localized strings and related release names.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a WHERE clause for searching bugs by name or bug number.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Populates notification template with bug details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the bean implements certain interfaces (here, ACL).

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides parent save method to persist bug data.
